items.name: Beso's Shawarma
items.about: Beso's Shawarma is a short, narrative-driven horror game. A late-night call lures you on a surreal journey through empty streets to a sketchy shawarma shop. Talk to a cast of strange characters, make a terrifying choice, and try to escape a disjointed, looping nightmare.

items.name: Gatekeeper Simulator: Inner Circle
items.about: You guard the gate of a secret society. Every visitor lies, some better than others. Inspect, decide, and live with the consequences of who you let inside.

items.name: The Seven Enchantments
items.langs: English, Russian, Georgianlanguages with full audio support
items.about: A first-person folk horror story about a scammer exorcist priest trapped in a cursed 19th-century village. Investigate the seven deadly sins by day and survive the forest spirits that hunt you at night.

items.name: Glass Cannon
items.about: Challenging and chill roguelike where you plan your shots carefully and creatively eliminate enemies using different weapon combinations. Buy weapon mods to create powerful synergies and clear all 24 rounds.

items.name: Gnomber
items.about: An action roguelike where you use different bombs to blow up your enemies. Use knockback from your explosions to throw enemies into each other or walls, throw projectiles and deal damage in creative ways. Level up, combine different perks, get new bombs, unlock new gnomes and become overpowered.

items.name: Queue Queen
items.about: A card-stacking roguelike where you quickly stack cards and trigger items to get points. Discover thousands of different items and make synergistic builds by customizing your deck and inventory to reach higher scores and break the game.

items.name: Man Pit
items.about: Man Pit is a challenging platformer with randomly generated levels and fluid and tight controls. As you journey out of the pit, you will learn to become a better man by finding wisdom and brothers along the way.

items.name: Plague Doctor VS The Profane
items.langs: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnameselanguages with full audio support
items.about: A fast-paced isometric slasher-shooter where you don't just hunt monsters—you become them. Manage your blood toxins, unleash brutal melee and ranged combos, and transform into defeated bosses to survive a relentless dark fantasy world. The only cure is violence.

items.name: Dumbriel: Magnificent Adventure in Hell
items.langs: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Georgian, Hindi
items.about: Dumbriel is a 2D metroidvania action-adventure set in Hell. Play as a clumsy fallen angel in a twisted underworld. Slash, craft, and dodge through deadly arenas, weird monsters, and hellish traps. Die, upgrade, and dive back in.

items.name: Mother Dear
items.about: "Mother Dear" is a heartwarming game where you play as a deer and follow a father's story told to his daughter about the childhood trauma that changed his life. Experience nature's beauty and uncover secrets of the father's past. With an emotional story, you'll have an unforgettable adventure
